relationships.claim: Anterior pituitary hormone secretion is regulated through hypothalamic neuroendocrine pathways, with additional feedback from peripheral target-gland hormones and intrapituitary mechanisms.

Anterior pituitary hormones act on peripheral glands or target tissues and participate in regulation of reproduction, growth and development, metabolism, environmental adaptation, and stress responses.

Endocrine axes include feedback links among the central nervous system, hypothalamus, anterior pituitary, target glands and tissues, while hormone secretion may also show pulsatile and time-dependent organization.
